result.title: CausalAlign: Causal Alignment of Video Generation Models for Consistent Ego-Motion
result.summary: Diffusion-based video generation models (VGMs) can produce visually plausible videos, yet their camera ego-motion often drifts over long horizons. Camera ego-motion determines how the viewpoint changes between frames and is essential for maintaining consistent geometry and trajectories. To address this problem, we propose CausalAlign, a causal alignment framework with two components. First, we diagnose how precise ego motion is represented, used, and retained within VGMs using linear probes and causal interventions, revealing a rise-and-fall pattern during denoising. Second, we strengthen ego-motion state in VGM by aligning the representations at the identified layers to a 3D foundation model through delta-token space. This space encodes the changes between consecutive frames, allowing the alignment to focus on ego-motion dynamics rather than static scene content. With Wan2.2 fine-tuned on DL3DV and RealEstate10K, CausalAlign can largely improve motion accuracy, geometric consistency, and temporal smoothness, while preserving visual quality. For example, it improves geometric consistency by more than 20% relative to the base model. Moreover, with the fine-tuned VGM, CausalAlign improves the success rate of world action models (WAMs) by 10 points on mobile manipulation tasks of RoboCasa365 benchmark. Overall, CausalAlign improves ego-motion consistency in diffusion-based VGMs and yields noticeable gains in embodied models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CausalAlign：先用线性探针与因果干预诊断扩散视频生成模型中相机自运动信息在去噪过程中的表征、使用与保持，呈「先升后降」模式；再在被识别的层上通过 delta-token 空间把自运动表征对齐到 3D 基础模型，以提升运动与几何一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「内部状态探针＋因果干预定位关键层，再对齐外部模型」的流程，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据在 latent 中是否被保留与使用提供可核查的诊断与监督线索；delta 表示侧重帧间变化而非静态内容，也与 latent 相似度中内容与结构因素之分有关。
